subject: Redwood private: decisioning and timeline check-in
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood private: VPC option & agreed next steps

Hi Elena — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick post-call recap and suggested next steps so nothing gets lost: 

Call highlights:
- Primary ask: evaluation of private deployment (VPC/on-prem) for FinLytics models with strict data residency.
- Scale profile: ~3M inference tokens/month initially; peak concurrent traffic expected ~30 qps.
- SLOs: 99.9% application-side availability target and p95 latency < 150ms for typical queries.
- Key constraints: procurement window (target H2 pilot start), SOC2 evidence required for legal.

Proposal summary / options we discussed:
1) Short pilot on Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pool) to validate latency/cost for 6 weeks, then transition to Private VPC for data residency.
2) Direct Private (VPC) deployment if you need immediate network isolation — includes customer-managed VPC peering and KMS integration.

Attachments I shared: SOW_Draft_v0.3.pdf (pilot scope + deliverables), SOC2_Audit_Summary.pdf (recent audit extract).

Requested next steps / asks:
- Can you confirm whether you want us to scope a 6-week dedicated pilot, or to go straight to a VPC setup?
- Who should we loop in from legal/procurement (name + email) so we can prepare terms and a high-level PO path?
- Target start window (earliest/ideal) for the pilot — is Q3 still realistic?

I'll also drop a short pricing guide and a one-page VPC checklist to make procurement and infra reviews quicker. Happy to set a 30-min follow-up with Marcus and Monica on our side to walk through network needs.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

[Attachments: SOW_Draft_v0.3.pdf, SOC2_Audit_Summary.pdf]

From: Elena Rossi <elena@finlytics.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>, procurement@finlytics.com
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood private: VPC option & agreed next steps

Thanks Jordan — good summary. Quick answers from our side: 

- Leadership lean: they're currently favoring a dedicated-reserved approach (predictable spend) but want a clear path to VPC within 3 months if the pilot hits the KPIs.
- Procurement request: can you send a ballpark for a 6-month reserved pilot (GPU sizing estimates + expected monthly token costs) so we can add a placeholder to the budget?
- Compliance: SOC2 summary is helpful; Legal will want a couple more artifacts (encryption at rest details, data retention policy).

Looping in procurement (jonathan.price@finlytics.com) explicitly — Jonathan, Jordan will send the pricing + SOW; can you flag any must-have contract terms?

Appreciate the speed — aiming to finalize whether to greenlight pilot by mid-May.

—Elena
Director, Platform Engineering
FinLytics

Subject: Re: Redwood private: VPC option & agreed next steps

Elena — quick follow to the procurement ask with a ballpark so you have something to drop into budgeting. Happy to refine after you give me an initial target GPU size.

Ballpark for 6-month reserved pilot (estimates):
- Baseline: 2 x A100-equivalent instances, continuous baseline capacity → $45k/mo (incl. support and monitoring).
- Burst plan: ability to add 1–2 instances for peak windows, billed at blended rate.
- Token estimate: ~3M tokens/month → incremental token-processing overhead ~ $1.20k/mo under current quantization/throughput profile.

Total rough monthly range: $46k–$55k for the pilot, with commit discounts available for 6+ month contracts.

Attachments: pricing_estimate_finlytics.xlsx (simple sheet with instance sizing and line items).
Links: DocuSign for SOW draft: https://redwood.app/docusign/abc123
Demo / staging cluster details: https://redwood-demo.redwood.ai/finlytics

Two quick notes:
- If legal needs encryption or retention specifics before a PO, Monica can supply the artifact set we usually provide to enterprise customers.
- If the priority shifts to immediate VPC, we can compress the network setup to ~3 weeks with an infra workshop (subject to mutual readiness).

Would you like a 30-min slot next week to walk procurement/legal through the checklist?

Best,
Jordan

Jordan — Jonathan on procurement. A few quick asks so procurement can move: 

1) Draft PO terms (payment net30; our standard liability cap language) — please indicate if Redwood requires different payment cadence.
2) Sample SOW with clear deliverables and acceptance criteria (we need this to attach to the PO).
3) Any preferred redlines on IP / data handling we should be aware of up front.

If you can send a single bundle (SOW + PO template + pricing sheet) I can flag the internal approvers and give you a realistic approval timeline.

Subject: Checking priority/timing for VPC path

Hi Elena / Jonathan — quick nudge on the packet Jonathan requested. I can assemble the PO-friendly bundle this afternoon (SOW + pricing sheet + standard PO terms + the SOC2 + encryption summary). Before I send, two quick clarifying asks so I pull the right level of detail: 

1) Priority: Is the current internal preference still a reserved/dedicated pilot with a path to VPC, or is there a hard requirement to land in a VPC immediately?
2) Timeline: you mentioned aiming to decide by mid-May — is that still the target, or has that slipped? If mid-May still works, I recommend a 30-min sync next week to run procurement through the bundle.

If I don’t hear back by EOD Wed I’ll go ahead and prepare the full bundle for Jonathan based on the dedicated-pilot path (we can always accelerate to VPC after pilot acceptance).

Thanks — appreciate the confirmation so we can align internal resource scheduling.

Regards,
